standard_prerequisites: Standard U_q(sl2) coproduct and rank-one Askey–Wilson representations; univariate q-Racah formulas
core_obligations: Taking the standard U_q(sl2) coproduct and rank-one Askey–Wilson/Leonard-pair and q-Racah formulas as priors, the remaining author construction couples five rank-two generators whose structure operators are not globally central but locally commute with the required pair. It builds compatible tensor-product eigenbases with parameters shifted by the other spectral index, identifies the normalized bivariate overlap, and derives the nine-term action including its corner coefficients from commutation consistency. The whole representation and bispectral construction is one H2 unit. An isolated quadratic ansatz, rank-one embedding, coefficient elimination or symmetry copy is supporting material rather than an independent H3 problem.
